description: Copy a region from a neighbouring screenshot at a fixed offset (use when auto alignment misses, e.g. small plain areas such as under a tooltip). Offsets are numbers, so edit them in a copy of this recipe per use (--set gives text only). Values here: AZDOC query <- Notification Email query, offset [7,3] measured from the Process/Search text blocks.

inputs.region: x0,y0,x1,y1 of the area in the DONOR
